## Why This Is Asked
Evaluate ability to design a production-ready, privacy-preserving NLP system across languages with measurable fairness and robust deployment controls.

## Key Concepts
- Multilingual NLP and code-switch handling
- PII redaction and privacy-by-design
- Drift detection and evaluation across languages
- Canary deployments and rollback strategies

## Code Example
```python
def redact_text(text, pii_model):
    tokens = text.split()
    for i, t in enumerate(tokens):
        if pii_model.is_pii(t):
            tokens[i] = '[REDACTED]'
    return ' '.join(tokens)
```
